questions.question: MEMORY.md should contain...
options: One line per note, linking to the file
questions.explanation: MEMORY.md is an index. Content lives in one-fact files. Keeps the context light.

questions.question: A weekly cadence with due_dow 1 fires...
options: Once per week, from Monday on, thanks to a sentinel file
questions.explanation: The hook checks the sentinel for this ISO week; fires once, then touches the sentinel.

questions.question: Where does an installed plugin live?
questions.explanation: Marketplace repos are cloned under ~/.claude/plugins; installed plugins are enabled in settings.

questions.question: STATUS.md is 10 days old with review-interval 7d. What tells you?
options: The staleness block of the cadence hook, once a day
questions.explanation: Machine-readable header + a daily hook = you get nagged. That is the state layer working.
